scenarios.name: Cancel a zoom window after its first corner

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with its rectangular solid active in the MCAD Software
its visible planar face occupies most of the viewport
the user chooses Zoom Window from the navigation bar Zoom menu
the user clicks a first corner within the face
the user presses Escape before choosing the opposite corner
the face retains its previous apparent size and position
the same part and orientation remain active
